description: This PHP class defines LDAPUserDataMapping, a data transfer object (DTO) for mapping LDAP user attributes such as first name, last name, email, employee ID, and user status. It includes getter and setter methods for each attribute, a toArray method for exporting the data, and a method to set attribute names from an array.

classes.name: LDAPUserDataMapping
classes.description: Data Transfer Object (DTO) encapsulating LDAP user attribute mappings with getter/setter methods, and utility functions for conversion.

methods.name: getFirstNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name used for the user's first name.

methods.name: setFirstNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the user's first name.

methods.name: getMiddleNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name used for the user's middle name, or null if not set.

methods.name: setMiddleNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the user's middle name.

methods.name: getLastNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name used for the user's last name.

methods.name: setLastNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the user's last name.

methods.name: getEmployeeIdAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name used for the employee ID, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmployeeIdAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the employee ID.

methods.name: getWorkEmailAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name used for the work email, or null if not set.

methods.name: setWorkEmailAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the work email.

methods.name: getUserStatusAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name used for user status, or null if not set.

methods.name: setUserStatusAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for user status.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the LDAPUserDataMapping object into an associative array.

methods.name: setAttributeNames
methods.description: Sets multiple LDAP attribute names from an input array.
